chunks: So We saved him and his family, except his wife; We destined her to be among those who stayed behind.

key_terms.الْغَابِرِينَ: Those who stay behind or remain (in the punishment/destruction)

ai.seo_question: Who was saved with Prophet Hud and who was left behind according to Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of individual accountability, noting that despite being part of the prophet's household, his wife was excluded from salvation due to her distinct lack of faith. The term 'al-ghabirin' (the remaining/dying) signifies her death or permanent exclusion from the saved group, illustrating that proximity to righteousness does not guarantee divine mercy without personal conviction.
